violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR Hot Box left side: black beans (111f), barbacoa (130f), chipotle mushrooms (115f) 2) in the 1DR Hot Box right side: carnitas (126f), barbacoa (129f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS ON THE FLAT TOP TO 165f BEORE HOT HOLDING IN THE HOT BOXES AT 135f. FOOD WAS REHEATED DURING THE INSPECITON.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 2DWR under grill cooler: shredded lettuce (47f), sliced ham (48f) 2) in the 4DWR under flat top cooler: chicken wings (48f) Upon discussion with PIC, these coolers are every morning less than 2 hours prior to inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS TO THE WALK-IN TO COOL TO 41f BEFORE COLD HOLDING ON THE LINE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) vegetable stock
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. STAFF DISCARDED THE VEGETABLE STOCK. USE OR DISCARD ALL COOKED FOODS WITHIN 7 DAYS. Taco Bamba (Inspection Date: 06/23/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) sanitizer dispensers for the 3 compartment sink was observed not pulling sanitizer from the container. 2) 2DWR under grill cooler 3) 4DWR under flat top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CONTACT THE SANITIZER DISPENSER COMPANY TO REPAIR THE DISPENSER BEFORE USING.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINKS MEET 65-67F AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION. PIC REPAIRED ALL SINKS DURING INSPECTION BUT THE ONE NEAR THE ICE MACHINE, WHICH WAS STILL AT 67F AT THE END OF THE INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL HANDWASHING SINKS NEED TO MEET 100F. PLEASE ENSURE CORRECTION BY TIME OF FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SOUR CREAM AND SALSA VERDE AT 45 IN ONE-DOOR GLASS FRONT UNDER-COUNTER COOLER; OBSERVED SALSA VERDE AND SALSA ARBOL AT 56F ON ICE BATH; OBSERVED GRILLED CHICKEN WINGS AT 53F, STEAK AT 50F, GRILLED CHICKEN AT 48F, SHREDDED CHEESE AT 45F, RAW FISH AT 46F, AND RAW CHORIZO AT 46F IN 4-DRAWER UNDER-GRILL COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOODS TO OTHER COOLERS DURING INSPECTION OR ADDED ICE TO ICE BATH. PLEASE ENSURE ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS ARE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. Taco Bamba (Inspection Date: 12/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED 4-DRAWER UNDER-GRILL COOLER AT 51F WITH EHS THERMOMETER (DIGITAL THERMOMETER READ AT 36F); OBSERVED 1-DOOR GLASS-FRONT COOLER FOR SAUCES AT THE BAR AT 44F. OBSERVED SANITIZER DISPENSER AT THE THREE-VAT SINK NOT DISPENSING SANITIZER AT THE PROPER CONCENTRATION.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED TCS FOOD ITEMS IN COOLERS TO OTHER PROPERLY COLD HOLDING COOLERS/FREEZERS. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING COOLERS SHOULD BE KEPT BETWEEN 34-38F. PLEASE ENSURE COOLERS ARE REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PIC SET UP THREE-COMPARTMENT SINK WITH BLEACH. PLEASE ENSURE THE DISPENSER IS REPAIRED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PIC PLACED WORK ORDER DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Water Pressure Meets Facility Demands
violations.observation: Hot water under insufficient or inadequate pressure was found to serve the following equipment: HANDWASHING SINK NEXT TO ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, equipment, and nonfood equipment that are required to use water. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINK PRESSURE IS REPAIRED BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC PURCHASED APPROVED SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: PIC WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR SHRIMP, CALAMARI, AND CRAWFISH THAT IS SERVED IN CEVICHE.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC CONTACTED VENDOR DURING INSPECTION WHOM INFORMED THE EHS/PIC THAT THEY WILL SEND THE UPDATED LETTER BY 7/11/25. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH THE LETTER AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety foods are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED COOKED BIRRIA AT 80F MADE 7 HOURS PRIOR AND COOKED BLACK BEANS AT 71F MADE 5 HOURS PRIOR IN THE WALK-IN COOLER..
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS COOLING FOODS MUST COOL FROM 135F TO 70F WITHIN 2 HOURS. PROPER COOLING METHODS WERE DISCUSSED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED PORK AT 48F AND CHICKEN WINGS AT 49F IN 4DWR UNDER-STOVE COORT; OBSERVED HABANERO SALSA AT 45-47F AND POBLANO SALSA AT 48-50F IN 1-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COCA COLA COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF FOODS DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE COOLERS SHOULD BE KEPT BETWEEN 34-38F AND SHOULD NOT BE USED FOR TCS FOODS UNLESS THEY CAN MAINTAIN PROPER TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located NEAR WALK-IN COOLER WAS BLOCKED BY KEGS/FOOD DELIVERY AND HANDWASHING SINK NEAR THREE- VAT SINK WAS BLOCKED BY MEAT SLICER AND TABLE, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED ALL ITEMS BLOCKING HANDWASHING SINK DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED FLASH FRIED COD (NOT-FULLY COOKED) IN FOUR-DRAWER UNDER-STOVE COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PIC UNDERSTANDS NO RAW ANIMAL FOODS SHOULD BE PARTIALLY COOKED WITHOUT SUBMITTING APPROVED WRITTEN PLANS/PROCEDURES TO HEALTH DEPARTMENT. ESTABLISHMENT WILL DISCONTINUE PROCESS AND WILL REACH OUT TO EHS IF ESTABLISHMENT WANTS TO CONTINUE PROCESS.
